items.title: Why Hardware Specialization is Back
items.summary: Thirty years ago, general-purpose chips beat specialized ones in the semiconductor industry’s great strategy debate. Today the same debate is back, but with new constraints.

items.title: Year-old AI lab Flapping Airplanes raises $1B at a $6B valuation
items.summary: Just 9 months after raising an $180 million seed round, Flapping Airplanes has landed $1 billion Series A for its mission to build AI models "without ingesting half the internet."

items.title: Rosie Bags $7M in Financing
items.summary: SEATTLE, WA, Rosie, the membership for flexible childcare and household support, today announced that it has raised $7 million across two oversubscribed financing rounds.
